mapper.select: SELECT supplier_id FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT client_ord FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order WHERE supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND sold_to=#{sold_to} AND requested_delivery_date=#{requested_delivery_date} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order SET status=#{status},supplier_result_code=#{supplier_result_code}, supplier_result_message=#{supplier_result_message},mod_at=NOW(), confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='CONFIRMED' THEN NOW() ELSE confirmed_at END WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND status NOT IN ('RECEIVED','PARTIAL_RECEIVED','CANCELED')

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item SET item_status=#{item_status},supplier_result_code=#{supplier_result_code}, supplier_error_message=#{supplier_error_message},mod_at=NOW() WHERE purchase_order_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} AND received_order_qty=0 AND item_status!='CANCELED'

UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_api_exchange SET response_payload=#{response_payload},exchange_status=#{status}, provider_result_code=#{supplier_result_code},provider_result_message=#{supplier_result_message},completed_at=NOW() WHERE correlation_id=#{purchase_order_id} AND operation_type='ORDER'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance(account_id,ingredient_id,location_id,current_base_qty,base_unit,current_unit,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{ingredient_id},#{location_id},0,#{base_unit},#{base_unit},#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE inventory_balance_id=inventory_balance_id
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item SET source_ingredient_id=#{ingredient_id},base_qty_per_order_unit=#{base_qty_per_order_unit},base_unit=#{base_unit},mod_at=NOW() WHERE purchase_order_item_id=#{purchase_order_item_id} AND (source_ingredient_id IS NULL OR source_ingredient_id='' OR received_order_qty=0)
mapper.select: SELECT i.* FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i JOIN the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt r ON r.goods_receipt_id=i.goods_receipt_id WHERE r.account_id=#{account_id} AND r.supplier_id=#{supplier_id} AND i.provider_line_key=#{provider_line_key} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt r SET total_supply_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.supply_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_vat=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.vat_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), total_amount=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.total_amount),0) FROM the_full_order.tb_goods_receipt_item i WHERE i.goods_receipt_id=r.goods_receipt_id), inventory_posted_at=NOW(),mod_at=NOW() WHERE goods_receipt_id=#{goods_receipt_id}
